name: Rolling Papers | Raw Classic (King Size)
description: RAW Classic Kingsize papers are designed for smokers who prefer a longer smoke. The introduction of RAW Classic changed the smoking landscape forever by introducing smokers to high quality papers that allow you to enjoy your smoke as nature intended!
